# Best Catering Philippines

> We find, vet, and manage the right caterer for weddings, debuts, christenings, and milestone celebrations across the Philippines. One clear quote, one point of contact, one guarantee.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://bestcateringphilippines.com/): overview, guarantee, how it works
- [Our Promise](https://bestcateringphilippines.com/our-promise): the three-part guarantee, stated in full
- [Occasions](https://bestcateringphilippines.com/occasions): weddings, debuts, christenings, birthdays, graduations, corporate events, Christmas, New Year
- [Locations](https://bestcateringphilippines.com/locations): Metro Manila, Calabarzon, Palawan, Cebu, Baguio, La Union, Ilocos, Clark, Subic, Boracay
- [Journal](https://bestcateringphilippines.com/journal): local planning guides by city and occasion
- [Vendor Application](https://bestcateringphilippines.com/vendor-application): for catering businesses joining our vetted bench (not for customers)

## Key facts

- Managed bookings start at 50 to 100+ guests and 150,000 pesos
- Quotes are returned within 24 hours
- No public pricing is shown; every booking is a custom quote
- The fulfilling caterer is never publicly named (BCP manages the relationship end to end)
